surface.module_def: defined in an omnilss module, not exported
surface.registry: family present in the OmniLSS capability registry (kernels in the kernel layer)

kernel.registry impl status: family-linked symbols use the registry implementation_status

parity.golden:<tier>: family has a fixed-R golden fixture plus the capability tier above

admission.exported_api: part of the supported public API
admission.not_available: no Python symbol, production routing cannot select it
admission.blocked: family registered but not production safe
